drinkWater.title: Drink water every 2 hours
drinkWater.desc: Keep your body hydrated. Drink a full glass of water (approx. 250ml) to stay refreshed and energized.

takeMedicine.title: Take medicine
takeMedicine.desc: Take your prescribed daily medications and vitamins with a full glass of water after meals.

stretchBreak.title: Stretch break
stretchBreak.desc: Stand up, roll shoulders back, stretch neck, spine, and hamstrings to release tension from sitting.

windDown.title: Night wind-down & sleep prep
windDown.desc: Dim the room lights, turn off notifications, and prep for 8 restful hours of sleep.

morningWorkout.title: Morning workout
morningWorkout.desc: Complete 30-45 minutes of strength training, calisthenics, HIIT, or mobility exercises.

eveningWalk.title: Evening walk
eveningWalk.desc: Take a relaxing 20-30 minute walk outdoors to digest, relax your mind, and reach your daily step count.

coreMobility.title: Core & mobility session
coreMobility.desc: Spend 15 minutes targeting core stability, hip openers, and lower back relief.

reviseNotes.title: Revise notes
reviseNotes.desc: Active recall and spaced repetition session on today's lecture notes, articles, or flashcards.

read20Pages.title: Read 20 pages
read20Pages.desc: Read 20 pages of your current non-fiction book, technical paper, or personal development reading.

languageDrill.title: Language or vocabulary drill
languageDrill.desc: 15 minutes of immersive listening or flashcard practice in your target language.

dailyPlanning.title: Daily planning 9 AM
dailyPlanning.desc: Identify the top 3 must-win goals for today, review calendar appointments, and triage urgent emails.

weeklyReview.title: Weekly review
weeklyReview.desc: Audit completed tasks, reconcile pending deliverables, log accomplishments, and plan the upcoming week.

inboxZero.title: Inbox triage & zero check
inboxZero.desc: Archive resolved threads, snooze non-urgent questions, and reply to priority correspondence.

callFamily.title: Call family
callFamily.desc: Call parents, grandparents, or siblings to check in, share updates, and nurture family bonds.

payBills.title: Pay bills monthly
payBills.desc: Pay utility bills, credit card statements, rent/mortgage, subscriptions, and update your personal budget.

birthdayYearly.title: Birthday yearly
birthdayYearly.desc: Send sincere birthday greetings, card, or gifts to celebrate special milestones.

homeDeclutter.title: Weekly home reset & declutter
homeDeclutter.desc: Clean desks, do laundry, take out recycling, and restock home essentials.

scrollingBreak.title: Take a break from scrolling
scrollingBreak.desc: Look away from the screen for at least 2 minutes. Focus on an object 20 feet away (20-20-20 rule) and blink gently.

screenCurfew.title: Night screen curfew
screenCurfew.desc: Put all mobile phones, tablets, and laptops in another room 45 minutes before sleep to avoid blue light disruption.

guide.title: How to Use DayPilot

guide.drawOverOtherAppsTitle: Getting Reminders While Using Other Apps
guide.drawOverOtherAppsBody: Web browsers running on mobile and desktop cannot draw pop-up overlays over other applications due to operating system security sandboxes. To receive guaranteed alerts while using other apps, install DayPilot as a PWA and enable Push Notifications.
